name: Gold Laced Throat
source:
Gold marks those who sacrifice their flesh and blood to god. You are Eunokia Malandra, one such holy warrior whose life-long duty is to duel with Katherine Snow, another lamb who gave up everything for ceremonial duty. The pressure of one sacrifice after another without hearing a single divine whisper has piled up over the years, a wall between you and those you should be protecting.

[i]You yearn for an answer, whatever it may be.

You yearn for her, fellow sacrificial pawn.

You yearn for her, chained together in gold and blood.[/i]

[From [url=https://sidesteph.itch.io/gold-laced-throat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黄金标志着那些向上帝牺牲自己的血肉的人。你是尤诺基亚·马兰德拉（Eunokia Malandra），一位这样的神圣战士，她的终生职责就是与凯瑟琳·斯诺（Katherine Snow）决斗，凯瑟琳·斯诺是另一只为了仪式职责而放弃一切的羔羊。多年来，一次又一次的牺牲而没有听到任何神圣的低语的压力已经堆积起来，在你和你应该保护的人之间有一堵墙。

[i]你渴望得到一个答案，无论它是什么。

你渴望她，牺牲品同伴。

你渴望她，被金与血束缚在一起。[/i]

[来自[url=https://sidesteph.itch.io/gold-laced-throat]itch.io[/url]]
